items.title: Sheila Jordan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I wrote some beautiful lyrics to commemorate Dannie... To a tune by Dannie called Soft Seas.

ctx.x: Not to brag, but I thought… and then I doubted… I said, “Did you write those?” [laughs] I said, “Did you really write those?” Brown, C.: You did.
And then he got me to write some lyrics to, um, Dannie Richmond‟s… Brown, C.: To a tune by Dannie called Soft Seas.
